data.title: Tonino Lamborghini Residences
data.about:
Tonino Lamborghini Residences is a residential complex consisting of 4 buildings from the developer Gulf Land Property. Located in the developed area of Nad Al Sheba, Dubai. The towers have 6 and 12 floors with podiums, made by Italian craftsmen and embodies the dynamic energy of the city and the modern aspect of the architectural style.

For sale are spacious apartments with 1-4 bedrooms with stunning views. The interior is filled with elegant materials and bold design, conveying the spirit of the legendary Italian style, complemented by modern automation.

The complex has a swimming pool, there is also a gym with high-end equipment, treadmills, baths and saunas, common areas for business meetings and events, a children's pool. The convenient location provides fast and convenient communication with various destinations and infrastructure facilities. The Al Ain Road connecting to the main areas of Dubai is located nearby, Meydan Racetrack is just a 5-minute drive away, and the road to Downtown Dubai and the Dubai Hills Estate Mall and Dubai International Airport takes about 15 minutes.
